input.content:
Biogas plant BGA10 consists of two parallel digestion lines that are merged only in the digestate store. Two solid feeders (Dos 1 and Dos 2, 50 cubic metres each, hydraulic push-floor) charge digesters F1 and F2 respectively; two pre-pits (6×8 m each, approx. 25 cubic metres) pump cattle slurry into F1 and F2 respectively.

Digesters F1 and F2 each have a diameter of 27 m and a wall height of 6 m, are equipped with three paddle agitators each and carry dome roofs with a gas space (including headspace) of 830 cubic metres each; they run mesophilically at 39 degrees Celsius (312.15 K) with a fill level of 90 percent. The digestate continues line by line: from F1 into post-digester N1 and from F2 into post-digester N2. Both post-digesters are structurally identical to the digesters (27 m diameter, 6 m wall height, gas space 830 cubic metres each, 39 degrees Celsius, fill level 90 percent) and fitted with one paddle and one long-axis agitator each. From N1 and N2 the digestate passes into the shared digestate store G1 with 32 m diameter, 8 m wall height, three submersible agitators and a gas space (including headspace) of 1,450 cubic metres; the store is unheated (approx. 20 degrees Celsius / 293.15 K), fill level 90 percent.

The biogas of all tanks runs through a gas collecting pipe to a CHP unit with a rated electrical output of 750 kW (electrical 42 percent, thermal 43 percent); besides the digester heating the heat supplies a small district heating network. Air is blown into the gas spaces of N1 and N2 for desulphurisation. An emergency flare rated 900 cubic metres per hour and a condensate shaft are present.

Substrate feed: 20 t/d maize silage each through the feeders (Dos 1 into F1, Dos 2 into F2) and 15 cubic metres per day of cattle slurry each from the pre-pits (into F1 and F2).
